quick: Oral 250-500 mg q12h; IV 750 mg-1.5 g q8h
No established risk; use if needed
summary: Cefuroxime is a second-generation cephalosporin available as oral cefuroxime axetil (tablets/suspension) and IV/IM cefuroxime sodium. Oral form treats respiratory, skin, urinary, and early Lyme infections; the parenteral form covers more serious infections including meningitis and septicemia. Dose interval is extended in significant renal impairment.
indications: Lower respiratory tract infections incl. pneumonia (IV)

dosage.d: 1.5 g pre-op; 750 mg q8h if prolonged
dosage.n: Open-heart: 1.5 g at induction then q12h to total 6 g
Not to exceed max adult dose

dosage.c: Pediatric otitis media / sinusitis (can swallow tablet)
dosage.n: Suspension if cannot swallow tablet whole

admin: Tablets: give with or without food (absorption greater after food)
Tablets and oral suspension are NOT bioequivalent and not interchangeable mg-for-mg
Crushed tablet has a strong, persistent bitter taste - use suspension if unable to swallow whole
IV product (with dextrose) is for intravenous administration only
Continue therapy at least 48-72 hours after patient becomes asymptomatic
Obtain culture/susceptibility before starting when possible
moa: Beta-lactam that binds penicillin-binding proteins, inhibiting bacterial cell-wall (peptidoglycan) synthesis; bactericidal. Stable against many beta-lactamases.

absolute: Known hypersensitivity (e.g., anaphylaxis) to cefuroxime or other cephalosporins
IV dextrose-containing product: hypersensitivity to corn products
relative: History of penicillin/beta-lactam hypersensitivity or multiple allergies
History of GI disease, particularly colitis
monitor: Diarrhea suggestive of C. difficile colitis

preg: Human data have not established drug-associated risk; no adverse outcomes in animal studies. Use if needed.
lact: Excreted in human milk; use with caution in nursing women.
renal: Adjust dosing interval if CrCl <30 mL/min (oral) / reduced renal function (IV). Dialyzable - give extra dose after hemodialysis.

moderate: Probenecid (slows tubular secretion: higher peak levels and ~30% longer half-life)
Other nephrotoxic agents (e.g., aminoglycosides) - additive renal risk
interactions.food: Oral tablet absorption increases when taken after food (bioavailability ~37% to ~52%); may be taken with or without food.
interactions.diagnostics: May cause false-positive urine glucose (non-enzymatic methods) and false-positive/negative ferricyanide blood-glucose tests; may interfere with creatinine and Coombs testing.

serious: Severe cutaneous reactions (e.g., Stevens-Johnson, erythema multiforme)
emergency: Severe skin reaction with blistering or mucosal involvement

monitoring: Assess for penicillin/cephalosporin/beta-lactam allergy before first dose
Watch for hypersensitivity during and after administration
Monitor for diarrhea / signs of C. difficile colitis
Renal function to guide dose-interval adjustment
Prolonged therapy: periodic CBC, renal and hepatic function
counsel: Take tablets as directed; absorption is better after food but may be taken either way
Tablet and suspension are not interchangeable mg-for-mg
Crushed tablet is very bitter - swallow whole or use the suspension
Report rash, itching, swelling, trouble breathing, or severe/bloody diarrhea immediately
Tell clinician about all penicillin or cephalosporin allergies
pk: Oral: rapid after esterase hydrolysis to cefuroxime
Oral tablet ~2-3 h (e.g., 7 mcg/mL after 500 mg)
Store per label; reconstituted suspension per stability instructions
pearls: Available both orally (cefuroxime axetil) and parenterally (cefuroxime sodium IV/IM) - same active drug, different routes.
Oral tablet absorption rises with food (bioavailability ~37% to ~52%), so taking after meals improves levels.
Tablets and oral suspension are NOT bioequivalent - do not substitute mg-for-mg.
One of the few oral cephalosporins indicated for early Lyme disease (500 mg q12h for 20 days).
Eliminated primarily by the kidney; extend the dosing interval when CrCl <30 mL/min and give an extra dose after hemodialysis.
Probenecid raises serum levels by slowing renal tubular secretion.
missed: Take the missed oral dose as soon as remembered; skip if near the next dose - do not double up.
overdose: Cephalosporin overdose can cause cerebral irritation and seizures; provide supportive care. Serum levels reduced by hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis.
